run_main: run the main function to power on a Spot robot and make it sit
create_spot_instance: create a Spot instance with the name RolloverClient to control a Boston Dynamics Spot robot
use_spot_get_lease: use the Spot get_lease context manager to acquire a lease before controlling the robot
call_spot_power_on: call the Spot power_on method to power on the robot before issuing movement commands
call_spot_sit: call the Spot sit method to make the robot transition into a sitting position
